translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

content: Degine, nibneggi ibmar-wilubgan-dummad daklealid: Ome-wargwen dad-ibeler-mola yoi, e-mali-urba nii nai, degine, e-nonogine olo-gurgin niskwa-gwaambe-gakabo naibalid.
Omegwa gurgin-nika gudisoggu, e-ibagan mosgu, nue e-bonigan itoargu, ise-ogormakar maid.
Geb degi nibneggi wilub-baid daklearbalid, achu-simudubaled-ginnid, nono-gwagugle nikad, degine, e-bebe-ambe-nikbalid, degine, e-nonomar-irba olo-gurgin bukwabalid.

Niskwamar-niba-nanaid sogapaa-mimmilesad achu-simudubaled na e-bunnugi we-niskwamar-danagwen ebipisad, degine, geb napnegse obatialid. Geb degi achu-simudubaled ome-ega-bipigwad-ukle-sokalid-asabin gwisgunonikid, adi ome-e-bipigwad megnonikir, abin-gunnegar.
Omega susugwa ega uklenonikid. We-susugwa bela yar-mamaidgi eskoroyobi dutusuli neg-semai guoed. We-machigwa ikiir sulenonikid, Bab Dummad, na-e-olo-ganagi-siidse sedegar.
Omegwa nega-dule-sulidganba wakited, bia Bab Dummad ega neg guagwar sisadse, agi iba-miligwen-gaka-dulataled-ilabo-gaka-dulapaa (1,260) akwedii-gumalagar.
Geb degine, nibneggi urwed-dummad nagunonikid: Miguel, degi, e-angermar achu-simudubaled-ebo urwenagusad. Achu-simudubaled, degine, e-angermar urwenagusmar-inigwele,
ar amar-urwenanaid gwen nakwissurmalad. Degisoggu, nibneggi neg-sate gunonimalad, bar nibneggi gwen daklessurmalad.

Degisoggu, achu-simudubaled-dummad melledsunnad. We-achu-simudubaledde naibe-gebesailaunnid, Satanásye-nugad, nia-saila, we dulemar-bela-napneg-naidgi-yardakdiid-duled. We-achu-simudubaled we-napnegse egwadlenonisunnad, degine, e-angermar bela eba egwallenonimarmosunnad.
Geb degi nibneggi gaya-burba binnasur gole an itosad, soge:

content.text: degine, Bab Dummad gandikidba na neg-dakmai-gunonisunnad,
degine, gandikidba na Cristo neg-seoed nonimosunnad,
ar ade nia-saila anmar-gwenadgangi Bab-Dummad-asabin sunmaknoni-daed,
Ar ade bemarse nia-saila nue-urwedigine aidenonikid,
ar na wisid, e-ibagan ichee napi naid.

content: Achu-simudubaled napnegse egwalles na itoargua, ome-susugwa-ega-uklesad-baregitesunnad.
A-omega sulubagi-dummad-e-sakan-warbo ega uklesad, adi naibe-idu nega-dule-sulidganba gukuegar, na e-negse. Agi birgapaa-abala akwemaloed.
Naibe e-gaya-yaba diwaryobi omegi dii eoalid, adi ome digi selegegar.
Ar napa ome-bendaknonikid. Napa argaded, adi diwar-achu-simudubaled-e-gaya-yaba-eosad napa-yaba ubogegar.
Geb degi achu-simudubaled omegi nue-sae-itoded. A-ular ome-e-mimmimar-baidse urwenadsunnad, dulemar-Bab-Dummad-igar-mamaidba-nanadimaladse, degine, Jesucristo-igar-sogsadba-nue-nanadimaladse.
